name: Countercheck Buyer Gate
description: Countercheck buyer agent for Concordium Testnet. Its public A2A interface performs read-only Registry checks and x402 quote inspection; local payment authorization remains disabled unless a person explicitly enables and reviews the signing flow. The A2A interface cannot sign or submit payments.

skills.name: Verify counterparties
skills.description: Read-only check of configured buyer and seller Concordium Testnet badges, Agent Card hashes, and registered payment wallets. Send the exact request verify_counterparties.

skills.name: Request purchase quote
skills.description: Read-only live validation of the seller x402 challenge against the configured Testnet CCD amount cap, recipient, network, expiry, and sponsor. Does not sign or settle. Send the exact request request_purchase_quote.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge: on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner, Active status, and exact Agent Card SHA-256 metadata hash.
